accepted_answers.name: APScheduler
accepted_answers.why: Standard in-process scheduler: cron/interval/date triggers, timezone-aware, persistent job stores.

accepted_answers.name: Celery Beat
accepted_answers.why: Accepted for distributed workloads: periodic tasks routed through the Celery broker/worker fleet.

notes: Moderate consensus: APScheduler for single-process cron-like scheduling, Celery Beat when workers are distributed. A hand-rolled time.sleep loop drifts, misses triggers across restarts, and has no persistence.
problem: Running scheduled/cron-like background tasks in Python with hand-rolled sleep loops.
